legal.privacyBody: EduVerse collects the minimum needed to run: your email (EduID login), your saved lessons, study plans, quiz answers, and focus sessions. We never sell your data. Analytics are privacy-friendly (Cloudflare Web Analytics, no advertising cookies). Contact us anytime to export or delete your data.
legal.termsBody: Core curricula content is free for personal study. Paid courses (later) have their own terms at purchase. Don't abuse the service (spam, scraping, fake accounts) — accounts breaking this may be suspended. Islamic content is provided as-is for learning.
legal.contactBody: Questions? Write to abdallah.mustafa.taha@gmail.com — we reply within a few days.
